body: The link ends up being pretty huge, filling up my entire terminal emulator. I think this would be a good time to use a [hyperlink](https://gist.github.com/egmontkob/eb114294efbcd5adb1944c9f3cb5feda) (or maybe generating a https://git.io/ shortened link 🤔 )
Given how many parameters there are, I think it would be a good idea to use [named parameters](https://doc.rust-lang.org/std/fmt/#named-parameters) to make future adjustments easier.

This definitely needs to be changed in the bug template, but we might as well fix it here too 😛 
```suggestion
```toml
```
I went with using git.io. It feels like a better solution, especially considering not all terminal emulators supporting hyperlinks (though I must admit support is impressive).

This is where starship would be initialized for ion:
```suggestion
            "ion" => Some(.config/ion/initrc"),
```

Just a bit of clarification:
```suggestion
- {shell_name} version: {shell_version}
```

I'd rather we don't call attention to being unable to launch the browser:
```suggestion
            "Click this link to create a GitHub issue populated with your configuration:\n\n  {}",
```

Here's a nice header for folks who have used this feature:

```suggestion
    let body = urlencoding::encode(&format!("<!--
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                                                        │
│   This issue has been pre-populated with your system's configuration   │
│               ♥ Thank you for submitting a bug report ♥                │
│                                                                        │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
-->

## Bug Report
```
